fields.subject: Expression Debug View
fields.condition: the visited expression node is a conditional, block, switch, loop, try, label, or goto node
fields.response: render the node using a brace-delimited keyword block matching its control construct: `.If (test) { ifTrue } .Else { ifFalse }` for a conditional; `.Block<Type>` (the block expression's own type) followed by a parenthesized, comma-separated list of its declared variables (each rendered as `Type name`, or `Type& name` when passed by reference) and a `;`-separated braced body for a block; `.Switch (value) { .Case (test): body ... .Default: body }` for a switch and its cases; `.Loop { body }`, optionally preceded by its continue label and followed by its break label, for a loop; `.Try { body }` followed by each `.Catch (ExceptionType var) .If (filter) { handler }` and a trailing `.Finally { block }` or `.Fault { block }` for a try node; `.Label` followed, on an indented new line, by the rendering of its default value and then, after dedenting, `.LabelTarget name:` on its own new line for a label node; and `.GotoKind labelName { value }` for a goto node
fields.postcondition: the rendered body of each brace-delimited block is indented one level deeper than its enclosing construct and is dedented again when the construct closes
